**Generated by Plan Project Pipeline - Stage 4**  
**Date**: February 3, 2026  
**Status**: Working Document

## 1. Data Models

### 1.1 Scene Data Model

```typescript
interface SceneData {
  metadata: {
    path: string;              // "scenes/MainMenu.tscn"
    format: number;            // Godot format version (e.g., 3)
    modified: string;          // ISO 8601 timestamp
    size: number;              // File size in bytes
    dependencies: string[];    // External resources referenced
  };
  root: SceneNode;
}

interface SceneNode {
  name: string;                // "MainMenu"
  type: string;                // "Control", "CharacterBody2D", etc.
  parent: string | null;       // Parent node name (null for root)
  instance: string | null;     // Path to instanced scene
  properties: Record<string, any>;
  children: SceneNode[];
  scripts: string[];           // Attached script paths
}
```

### 1.2 Script Data Model

```typescript
interface ScriptData {
  metadata: {
    path: string;              // "scripts/Player.gd"
    language: "GDScript" | "C#";
    modified: string;
    size: number;
    lineCount: number;
  };
  content: string;             // Raw script content
  structure: {
    className: string | null;
    extends: string | null;
    signals: SignalDef[];
    constants: ConstantDef[];
    variables: VariableDef[];
    functions: FunctionDef[];
  };
}

interface FunctionDef {
  name: string;
  params: Array<{name: string; type?: string; default?: string}>;
  returnType?: string;
  lineStart: number;
  lineEnd: number;
}
```

### 1.3 Project Data Model

```typescript
interface ProjectStructure {
  projectPath: string;         // Absolute path to project root
  projectName: string;         // From project.godot
  godotVersion: string;        // "4.6.0"
  tree: FileNode;
}

interface FileNode {
  name: string;
  type: "directory" | "scene" | "script" | "resource" | "other";
  path: string;                // Relative to project root
  children?: FileNode[];       // For directories
  metadata?: {
    size: number;
    modified: string;
    mimeType: string;
  };
}
```

### 1.4 Resource Metadata Model

```typescript
interface ResourceMetadata {
  uri: string;                 // "godot://scenes/MainMenu.tscn"
  path: string;                // "scenes/MainMenu.tscn"
  type: "scene" | "script" | "resource";
  mimeType: string;            // "application/json", "text/x-gdscript"
  size: number;
  modified: string;
  checksum: string;            // SHA-256 for cache invalidation
}
```

## 2. File System Schema

### 2.1 Godot Project Directory Structure

```
my-godot-project/
├── project.godot           # Project configuration
├── addons/                 # Plugins (includes godot-mcp bridge)
│   └── godot-mcp/
│       ├── plugin.cfg
│       ├── http_server.gd
│       └── ...
├── scenes/                 # Scene files (.tscn)
│   ├── MainMenu.tscn
│   ├── levels/
│   │   ├── Level1.tscn
│   │   └── Level2.tscn
│   └── characters/
│       └── Player.tscn
├── scripts/                # GDScript files (.gd)
│   ├── Player.gd
│   ├── Enemy.gd
│   └── managers/
│       └── GameManager.gd
├── resources/              # Resources (.tres, .res)
│   ├── PlayerStats.tres
│   └── textures/
├── assets/                 # Raw assets (images, audio, etc.)
└── .godot/                 # Godot cache (excluded from MCP access)
```

### 2.2 File Format Specifications

**.tscn (Scene Text Format)**:
```
[gd_scene load_steps=3 format=3 uid="uid://abcdef123"]

[ext_resource type="Script" path="res://scripts/Player.gd" id="1"]
[ext_resource type="Texture2D" path="res://assets/player.png" id="2"]

[node name="Player" type="CharacterBody2D"]
script = ExtResource("1")
position = Vector2(100, 200)
velocity = Vector2(0, 0)

[node name="Sprite" type="Sprite2D" parent="."]
texture = ExtResource("2")
```

**.gd (GDScript Plain Text)**:
```gdscript
class_name Player extends CharacterBody2D

signal health_changed(new_health: int)

const MAX_SPEED: float = 300.0

@export var jump_velocity: float = -400.0

var health: int = 100:
	set(value):
		health = value
		health_changed.emit(health)

func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
	move_and_slide()
```

**project.godot (INI-like Format)**:
```
config_version=5

[application]
config/name="My Game"
run/main_scene="res://scenes/MainMenu.tscn"
config/features=PackedStringArray("4.6", "Forward Plus")

[rendering]
renderer/rendering_method="forward_plus"
```

## 3. Data Access Patterns

### 3.1 Read Operations

**Pattern: List Scenes**
```
Request → Cache Check (list:scenes) → [Cache Miss]
→ Godot FileSystem (DirAccess.get_files_at("res://scenes"))
→ Filter *.tscn → Build metadata list
→ Cache Result (TTL: 60s) → Return
```

**Pattern: Read Scene**
```
Request → Cache Check (scene:{path}) → [Cache Miss]
→ Godot FileSystem (FileAccess.open("res://scenes/X.tscn"))
→ Parse .tscn format → Build SceneData model
→ Cache Result (TTL: 300s) → Return
```

**Pattern: Search Nodes**
```
Request (query: "Player") → Cache Check (search:Player) → [Cache Miss]
→ List all scenes → For each scene:
   → Read scene (may hit cache) → Search nodes by name/type
→ Aggregate results → Cache (TTL: 60s) → Return
```

### 3.2 Write Operations

**Pattern: Create Scene**
```
Request (path, template) → Validate input (Zod schema)
→ Check file doesn't exist (no overwrite)
→ Generate .tscn content from template
→ Write to temp file (atomic)
→ Rename temp → target (atomic commit)
→ Invalidate caches (scene:{path}, list:scenes, search:*)
→ Audit log (who, when, what) → Return success
```

**Pattern: Modify Scene**
```
Request (path, changes) → Validate input
→ Backup original (copy to .tscn.backup)
→ Read current scene → Apply changes (node add/remove/modify)
→ Validate result (parse back, check references)
→ Write to temp → Rename (atomic)
→ Invalidate caches → Audit log → Return
```

### 3.3 Caching Strategy

| Data Type | Cache Key | TTL | Max Items | Invalidation Trigger |
|-----------|-----------|-----|-----------|---------------------|
| Scene list | `list:scenes` | 60s | 1 | Any scene create/delete |
| Scene data | `scene:{path}` | 300s | 50 | Write to same scene |
| Script list | `list:scripts` | 60s | 1 | Any script create/delete |
| Script data | `script:{path}` | 300s | 50 | Write to same script |
| Project structure | `project:structure` | 60s | 1 | Any file create/delete/move |
| Search results | `search:{query}` | 60s | 20 | Any scene/script write |

**Cache Implementation (Node.js LRU)**:
```typescript
import { LRUCache } from 'lru-cache';

const cache = new LRUCache<string, any>({
  max: 100,              // Max 100 items (~10MB)
  ttl: 300_000,          // Default 5min
  updateAgeOnGet: true,  // Reset TTL on access
  updateAgeOnHas: false,
});

// Per-type TTL overrides
function getCacheTTL(key: string): number {
  if (key.startsWith('list:')) return 60_000;
  if (key.startsWith('search:')) return 60_000;
  return 300_000; // Default
}
```

## 4. Data Transformation

### 4.1 .tscn → JSON Conversion

**Input** (.tscn text):
```
[node name="Player" type="CharacterBody2D"]
script = ExtResource("1")
position = Vector2(100, 200)

[node name="Sprite" type="Sprite2D" parent="."]
texture = ExtResource("2")
```

**Output** (JSON):
```json
{
  "nodes": [
    {
      "name": "Player",
      "type": "CharacterBody2D",
      "parent": null,
      "properties": {
        "script": "res://scripts/Player.gd",
        "position": {"x": 100, "y": 200}
      },
      "children": [
        {
          "name": "Sprite",
          "type": "Sprite2D",
          "parent": "Player",
          "properties": {
            "texture": "res://assets/player.png"
          }
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```

**Parsing Logic** (GDScript):
```gdscript
func parse_tscn_file(content: String) -> Dictionary:
    var lines = content.split("\n")
    var nodes = []
    var current_node = null
    
    for line in lines:
        if line.begins_with("[node"):
            if current_node: nodes.append(current_node)
            current_node = parse_node_header(line)
        elif current_node and line.contains("="):
            parse_node_property(line, current_node)
    
    if current_node: nodes.append(current_node)
    return {"nodes": build_hierarchy(nodes)}
```

### 4.2 GDScript Parsing (Extract Structure)

**Input** (.gd):
```gdscript
class_name Player extends CharacterBody2D

signal health_changed(value: int)

const MAX_SPEED: float = 300.0

func move(direction: Vector2) -> void:
    velocity = direction * MAX_SPEED
```

**Output** (JSON):
```json
{
  "className": "Player",
  "extends": "CharacterBody2D",
  "signals": [
    {"name": "health_changed", "params": [{"name": "value", "type": "int"}]}
  ],
  "constants": [
    {"name": "MAX_SPEED", "type": "float", "value": "300.0"}
  ],
  "functions": [
    {
      "name": "move",
      "params": [{"name": "direction", "type": "Vector2"}],
      "returnType": "void",
      "lineStart": 7,
      "lineEnd": 8
    }
  ]
}
```

**Parsing Logic** (Regex-based MVP):
```gdscript
func parse_gdscript_structure(content: String) -> Dictionary:
    return {
        "className": extract_class_name(content),
        "extends": extract_extends(content),
        "signals": extract_signals(content),
        "constants": extract_constants(content),
        "functions": extract_functions(content),
    }

func extract_functions(content: String) -> Array:
    var pattern = "func\\s+(\\w+)\\([^)]*\\)\\s*(?:->\\s*(\\w+))?"
    # ... regex parsing
```

## 5. Data Integrity

### 5.1 Atomic Write Operations

**Problem**: File writes can fail mid-operation, leaving corrupted files

**Solution**: Write to temp file, then atomic rename

```gdscript
func write_scene_atomic(path: String, content: String) -> Error:
    var temp_path = path + ".tmp"
    
    # Write to temp file
    var file = FileAccess.open(temp_path, FileAccess.WRITE)
    if file == null:
        return FileAccess.get_open_error()
    
    file.store_string(content)
    file.close()
    
    # Atomic rename (OS-level operation)
    var dir = DirAccess.open("res://")
    var err = dir.rename(temp_path, path)
    
    if err != OK:
        dir.remove(temp_path)  # Cleanup on failure
        return err
    
    return OK
```

**Guarantees**:
- ✅ File is either fully written or not at all (no partial writes)
- ✅ Rename is atomic on all modern filesystems (POSIX, NTFS)
- ✅ Original file remains intact if write fails

### 5.2 Backup Strategy

**Before Destructive Operations**:
```gdscript
func backup_file(path: String) -> String:
    var backup_path = path + ".backup"
    var dir = DirAccess.open("res://")
    dir.copy(path, backup_path)
    return backup_path

func modify_scene(path: String, changes: Dictionary) -> Error:
    # 1. Backup original
    var backup = backup_file(path)
    
    # 2. Attempt modification
    var result = apply_scene_changes(path, changes)
    
    # 3. Rollback on failure
    if result != OK:
        DirAccess.open("res://").rename(backup, path)
        return result
    
    # 4. Keep backup for 30 days (cleanup job)
    # Backup kept at: scenes/MainMenu.tscn.backup
    
    return OK
```

**Backup Retention**:
- Kept for 30 days (configurable)
- Cleanup job runs daily (Godot cron or external)
- User can manually restore via Sidecar UI

### 5.3 Validation Before Write

**Validation Pipeline**:
```typescript
async function validateSceneWrite(path: string, data: SceneData): Promise<void> {
  // 1. Path validation
  if (!path.endsWith('.tscn')) {
    throw new ValidationError('Invalid extension');
  }
  if (path.includes('..') || path.includes('~')) {
    throw new ValidationError('Path traversal detected');
  }
  
  // 2. Schema validation (Zod)
  sceneDataSchema.parse(data);
  
  // 3. Reference validation
  for (const dep of data.metadata.dependencies) {
    if (!await godotClient.fileExists(dep)) {
      throw new ValidationError(`Missing dependency: ${dep}`);
    }
  }
  
  // 4. Syntax validation (parse back)
  const tscnContent = serializeSceneToTSCN(data);
  const parsed = parseTS CN(tscnContent);
  if (!parsed) {
    throw new ValidationError('Generated invalid .tscn format');
  }
}
```

**Validation Checks**:
1. ✅ Path format and extension
2. ✅ No path traversal (`..`, symlinks)
3. ✅ Schema compliance (Zod validation)
4. ✅ External resource references exist
5. ✅ Generated content is valid (parse-back test)
6. ✅ No circular dependencies (scene references)

## 6. Data Flow Diagrams

### 6.1 Read Flow (Cache Hit)

```
[Client Request] → [Node.js Tool Handler]
    ↓
[Check Cache] → [Cache HIT!]
    ↓
[Return Cached Data] → [Client Response]

Latency: 1-2ms (in-memory lookup)
```

### 6.2 Read Flow (Cache Miss)

```
[Client Request] → [Node.js Tool Handler]
    ↓
[Check Cache] → [Cache MISS]
    ↓
[HTTP Request to Godot] (10-20ms)
    ↓
[Godot HTTP Server]
    ↓
[File I/O: FileAccess.open()] (5-20ms)
    ↓
[Parse .tscn → JSON] (10-30ms)
    ↓
[Return to Node.js] (10-20ms)
    ↓
[Store in Cache] → [Return to Client]

Latency: 45-110ms (full round-trip)
```

### 6.3 Write Flow (with Backup)

```
[Client Request] → [Node.js Tool Handler]
    ↓
[Validate Input] (Zod schema)
    ↓
[HTTP Request to Godot] (10-20ms)
    ↓
[Godot: Backup Original] (5-10ms)
    ↓
[Godot: Write to Temp File] (10-30ms)
    ↓
[Godot: Atomic Rename] (1-5ms)
    ↓
[Return to Node.js] (10-20ms)
    ↓
[Invalidate Caches] (1ms)
    ↓
[Audit Log] (async, 2-5ms)
    ↓
[Return to Client]

Latency: 50-110ms (write operation)
```

### 6.4 Cache Invalidation Flow

```
[Write Operation Completes]
    ↓
[Identify Affected Cache Keys]:
    - Direct: cache.delete(`scene:${path}`)
    - Lists: cache.delete('list:scenes')
    - Searches: cache.deletePrefix('search:')
    - Project: cache.delete('project:structure')
    ↓
[Remove from Cache] (1ms per key)
    ↓
[Next Read]: Cache miss → Fresh data
```

## 7. Data Governance

### 7.1 Data Retention

- **Cache**: TTL-based (60s-300s), LRU eviction
- **Backups**: 30-day retention, daily cleanup
- **Audit Logs**: 30-day retention, rotated daily
- **Project Files**: Indefinite (user-managed)

### 7.2 Data Privacy

- **No Personal Data**: Godot project files contain game assets, no PII
- **Localhost-Only**: Data never leaves local machine (MVP)
- **No Telemetry**: No usage tracking in MVP (opt-in Phase 2)

### 7.3 Data Quality Metrics

- **Parse Success Rate**: >99% of .tscn files parse correctly
- **Cache Hit Rate**: >70% for read-heavy workflows
- **Backup Success Rate**: 100% (no failures tolerated)
- **Validation Pass Rate**: >95% (5% rejected as invalid)
